definitions.costs: Illustrative estimates only, never measured energy or latency.
definitions.overall_accuracy: Correct known-cause diagnoses / ALL incidents; abstentions count as not correct.
definitions.diagnosed_accuracy: Correct known-cause diagnoses / diagnosed incidents; null if none.
definitions.energy_per_correct: Estimated joules over ALL incidents / number correctly diagnosed; null if none.
definitions.brier_score: Mean unscaled multiclass sum of squared errors over ALL terminal posteriors.
definitions.reliability: Top-label confidence versus catalogue top-label accuracy across ALL incidents, including abstentions.
definitions.outside_catalogue: For Brier/reliability only, novel causes map to other_unknown; a known-cause diagnosis is always incorrect.
definitions.pairing: Policies and budgets reuse identical pre-sampled potential test outcomes; SHA256 fingerprints included.
